title: StudioBrain Runtime Requirements Metadata
description: Shared schema fragment describing what a provider or workflow needs at runtime: target platforms, environment variables, local models, and CLI binaries. Consumed by the installer / validator to refuse cloud execution of desktop-only assets and to prompt the user for missing keys.

platforms.description: Platforms this asset can run on. 'wire: process' providers and any localhost base_url must include 'desktop'; cloud workers 501 assets they cannot serve.

env.description: Environment variables (secrets / API keys) the user must set before running, e.g. FAL_KEY. Mirrors auth.env on providers.

models.description: Model ids resolved by the desktop model-manager gateway registry (e.g. 'pocket-tts'). Weights ship via the registry, not the installer.

binaries.description: CLI binaries that must be on PATH for 'wire: process' providers (e.g. 'blender', 'uvr', 'ffmpeg').
